claims.text: Tenant Delete from disk removes the backup from tenant console and database
For SOBR, Delete from disk removes backups from the archive tier
When tenant data was moved to capacity tier, files are not moved to recycle bin, only marked
VBM files are deleted immediately and not moved to recycle bin
Insider protection processes files differently depending on how they were offloaded
Tenant cannot restore from archive tier on its own; SP must retrieve archived data
SP must retrieve archived data using a Microsoft PowerShell cmdlet before tenant restore [4]
Publish-VBRCloudArchiveRestorePoint retrieves data from archive storage into capacity tier
Instant Recovery remains pending until data is retrieved from archive tier
Recovering data from archive tier is not supported in Veeam Backup & Replication

A.notes: [4] (tenant restore-message steps) does not mention a PowerShell cmdlet; [3] is an Orchestrator restore page, not a VBR statement; misses retention period, PowerShell-script download of deleted backups and the restore-point-ID message flow.

claims.text: Archive-tier deleted backups are only marked as moved to recycle bin, recorded in SP configuration database
Same mechanism applies to archive tier with insider protection
Record kept for days set in tenant account, then files removed from object tier
Tenant cannot restore from archive tier alone; SP must retrieve
Tenant gets 'Unable to restore from the Archive Tier...' message with restore point ID and sends it to SP
In Cloud Connect retrieval is only via PowerShell, not the console
Get-VBRCloudArchiveRestorePoint lists archive restore points; Publish-VBRCloudArchiveRestorePoint retrieves into capacity tier
SP notifies tenant, tenant reattempts restore from published restore point
For deleted backups in capacity tier, SP downloads files using Windows PowerShell scripts with Veeam Support

B.notes: Mentions the PowerShell-script download but not that files land in the performance-tier recycle bin and are removed from object storage.

claims.text: Kasten requires a Veeam Repository Location Profile in blockModeProfile of exportParameters to export snapshots
Kasten can send backup data to a Veeam VBR Repository via a location profile
Kasten does not support export to VBR direct object storage repositories
Filesystem-mode and block-mode export/delete/restore Pod types
Kasten provides application backups via RestorePoint/ClusterRestorePoint resources [3]
A VBR backup job is created for each Kasten policy
Immutable Veeam Repository requires following specific instructions
Used account must have access to backup repositories (plug-in page)
For cloud repositories VBR needs an IAM user / IAM role
Repository permissions must be granted beforehand
VBR grants access permissions on regular repositories to Veeam Agent users
Kasten expects Veeam repositories to have appropriate access permissions

A.notes: [3] is a troubleshooting page that does not support the RestorePoint claim; answer pads with off-topic plug-in/AWS/Agent permission material and never states the Backup Administrator role or the Allow-to permissions although [11] has them.

claims.text: Configure a Veeam Backup repository location profile with VBR server and target repository
Create a Kasten policy selecting that profile, or export a restore point manually
Exporting to a Veeam Repository requires block mode export, enabled automatically
VBR account must have Veeam Backup Administrator role or be in a group with it
With VBR on Linux, no domain user for Kasten location profiles
Repositories need Allow to everyone or Allow to the following accounts or groups only
Changing permissions on repositories with Kasten backups makes the policy fail

B.notes: Only omission: that the policy then appears in the VBR infrastructure.
